title: Why So Much Bad Strategy?
coreMove: Diagnose the social reward for ambiguity before accepting a plan as agreement.
sourcePressure: The source frames this as a causes chapter: institutions keep producing vague plans because ambiguity protects consensus, avoids painful choice, and lets rooms feel aligned before anything is excluded. Frozen source has no chapter-specific named figure, study, place, or event beyond the visible title/support notes; use conceptual source terms only and do not invent anchors.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Bad strategy persists because people are unintelligent or lazy.
